chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Sadir who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Sadir! Adhere to your house and be a cushion among its cushions, and remain settled as long as the night and day are settled. When it reaches you that Al-Sufani has emerged, then travel to us, even if on foot.'

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيَّ: Al-Sufani (the specific figure whose emergence signals a major event)
key_terms.حِلْساً: A cushion (metaphor for remaining settled and quiet)

ai.seo_question: What is the instruction for companions during the pre-emergence period before Al-Sufani?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructs Sadir to remain in seclusion and patience in his home during the period of quiet before the emergence of Al-Sufani. He commands him to stay put until the news of Sufani's rise arrives, at which point he should travel to the Imam, regardless of the difficulty of the journey.

en.hubeali: H 14831 – A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usmaan Bin Isa, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Sudeyr who said:
